title: Total-pipe Lossless Figure Inspection and Crop Request

operation.description: inspect renders a 100px pixel-ruler grid and auto-detected sub-panel candidate boxes; crop extracts an exact lossless [left, top, right, bottom] sub-rectangle.

source.description: Inventory asset_id (e.g. fig_03) or figure path inside the workflow/job workspace.

box.description: Required for operation=crop: integer pixel rectangle [left, top, right, bottom].

output_name.description: Optional filename under work/crops/ for operation=crop.

source_figure.description: Optional paper figure/sub-panel identifier (e.g. 3a, 2c, S4b) pre-populated into the returned Deck IR asset_entry.
